role: Re-exports five CANON §A.14 reinforcement schedules and their coordinator.
detail: Barrel module that centralizes exports for the behavioral contingencies subsystem. Exports five reinforcement schedule classes (SatisfactionHabituation, AnxietyAmplification, GuiltyRepair, SocialCommentQuality, CuriosityInformationGain) along with their factory functions (getOrCreate* variants) and associated types. Also exports ContingencyCoordinator and getOrCreateContingencyCoordinator. All five schedules are Type 1 (reflexive, non-blocking). These implement CANON §A.14 behavioral contingencies that shape Sylphie's personality through contingency-based learning.
